title: Grubhub Owned Food Delivery. Then DoorDash Buried It.
source: US online food delivery market share by company, as tracked by Bloomberg Second Measure and Edison Trends and reported by Fast Company, Food On Demand and Qz. Grubhub: 33% (2018), 26% (2019), 18% (2020), 15% (2021), 14% (2022), 10% (2023, est.). DoorDash: 18% (2018), 30% (2019), 52% (2020), 53% (2021), 59% (2022), 65% (2023, est.). DoorDash overtook Grubhub for the #1 spot in early 2019 and never looked back; Grubhub was later sold to Just Eat Takeaway and then Wonder Group.
